LI.FI: The Agentic Economy — A Deep Dive

title: Stablecoins displace card networks for agent payments because cards cannot price micropayments or settle continuously
content:
LI.FI's structural argument for why stablecoins replace traditional payment networks in the agentic economy — card systems cannot:

- **Price micropayments** — interchange floors sit near 10 cents
- **Settle continuously** — clearing runs on business days only
- **Clear cross-border** without correspondent banks

By contrast, Circle's gas-free USDC supports transfers as small as **$0.000001** (one millionth of a dollar), settled directly on mainnet, operating 24/7 without banking intermediaries.

**Scale check:** stablecoins already settle ~5x PayPal's volume and nearly half of Visa's.

**Why it matters:** agent workloads are exactly the shape cards exclude — tiny, constant, borderless.

Source: LI.FI, "The Agentic Economy — A Deep Dive" (https://li.fi/knowledge-hub/the-agentic-economy-%E2%80%94-a-deep-dive).
